items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: Interviewer mentions Red Norman in a photo context; Interviewee does not claim personal interaction or relationship.

ctx.x: And there you are hidden away on the back, next to the piano player, Marce Saskat. And Red Norman. Red Noonan. Noonan, I can't read. He's playing guitar. Yeah. And Mrs. Barbera playing. I see the photo. Blackout.
Blackout. She was a singer, huh?
